title: A Thanksgiving Dinner
subtitle: 考点：节日美食 / pumpkin pie / according to
passage: Thanksgiving is an important holiday in the United States. It is in November, and families get together for a big meal. Many families eat turkey, mashed potatoes and pumpkin pie.

Emma helps her mother make the pumpkin pie. First, they mix cooked pumpkin with cream, eggs and a little cinnamon. Then they pour the mixture into a pie crust. They bake the pie in the oven for about an hour. According to Emma's grandmother, the best pie always has a lot of cinnamon.

At six o'clock, ten people sit around the table. Before eating, each person says one thing they are thankful for. Emma says, “I am thankful for my family and for this delicious pie!” Everyone laughs. The pie is soft and sweet, and the whole house smells of cinnamon.
